input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a not a risk associated with An image recognition system is designed to analyze and categorize visual data, using machine learning algorithms to identify objects and people within photos. The system aims to automatically assign relevant tags and labels to images, facilitating organization and search functionality. It also seeks to improve its accuracy and capabilities through continuous learning and improvement.
